Pmpr reads the request and handles the transaction

I’m deeply saddened by what happened. Losing Pmpr isn’t just a loss for us as a community, it’s a loss for what could’ve been built for Solana and crypto as a whole.

I am a dev that loves building new and exciting things and putting them out there for the community to do with them as they please, as you might have seen with some of my prior projects. For the first hour after launching Pmpr, I didn’t see the potential in Pmpr that you guys saw, but it quickly became very clear how much something like this is in demand and how hard people were willing to rally behind it.

So I pushed the project with everything I that I have. I pushed through constant fud waves, spam, abusive behavior from some users on the platform, the suspension, rallying to get twitter to unsuspend us, watching the logs and launches like a hawk for 18-19 hours a day, answering questions about the platform, constants bug fixes, all while shipping and building through, and pushing major updates and features to the platform, didn’t leave a stone unturned, didn’t ever stop upgrading and pushing. 

What was built and how fast it moved wasn’t normal.

I’m not sure why or who decided Pmpr shouldn’t be around, but the reality is we were operating in an open, competitive environment (X) where something like this could be taken down at any moment, and unfortunately in our case it did, twice, and I wasn’t going to keep pushing forward knowing that.

I want to take this moment to give a proper shoutout to everyone people who was here throughout this journey and this would not have been possible without their support, you all know who you are, I would tag everyone but X isn't playing around these days....

You guys were early, active, giving feedback, testing, giving me suggestions, pushing things forward, and actually using the product the way it was meant to be used to show CT what this is all about.

That didn’t go unnoticed at all
